mapper.select:
SELECT f.* FROM employment_filing f JOIN student s ON s.uuid = f.student_uuid JOIN class_info c ON c.id = s.class_id JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = #{userId} AND u.status = 1 AND u.account_type = 'STAFF' WHERE f.status = #{status}
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM college_admin a JOIN college co ON co.id = a.college_id WHERE a.user_id = u.id AND co.id = c.college_id )
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM counselor_class cc JOIN counselor counselor ON counselor.id = cc.counselor_id WHERE cc.counselor_id = u.counselor_id AND cc.class_id = c.id )
ORDER BY f.submitted_at DESC, f.id DESC
SELECT * FROM employment_filing WHERE id=#{id} FOR UPDATE

INSERT INTO `employment_filing`
created_at, updated_at, application_no, student_uuid, student_no, student_name, college, major, class_id, class_name, graduation_year, application_type, previous_filing_id, change_reason, destination_type, company_name, company_credit_code, company_industry, company_nature, job_title, work_province, work_city, work_address, monthly_salary, signed_date, contact_phone, contact_email, destination_details, materials, remark, status, submitted_at, archived_at, version,
VALUES
COALESCE(#{createdAt, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)), COALESCE(#{updatedAt, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)), #{applicationNo}, #{studentUuid}, #{studentNo}, #{studentName}, #{college}, #{major}, #{classId}, #{className}, #{graduationYear}, #{applicationType}, #{previousFilingId}, #{changeReason}, #{destinationType}, #{companyName}, #{companyCreditCode}, #{companyIndustry}, #{companyNature}, #{jobTitle}, #{workProvince}, #{workCity}, #{workAddress}, #{monthlySalary}, #{signedDate}, #{contactPhone}, #{contactEmail}, #{destinationDetails}, #{materials}, #{remark}, #{status}, #{submittedAt}, #{archivedAt}, #{version},
